svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given the reader's column-order control — *schematic first* ↔ *behavior first*; beat 1: you flip it → the header row and every beat row re-deal together, so no row can disagree with the header it sits under; beat 2: you page on to another requirement → it still reads in the order you chose — held for the session, stored nowhere
